purpose: Deterministic repair of the three second-live failures: unknown-slot qualifier safety, movement decision reconciliation, and mixed-intent obligation preservation. No model calls.
executive_summary: The three second-live failures are repaired deterministically. Unknown cause, actor, and time are no longer read as an event location when the sentence says they remain unseen. A resolved scene transition is copied into GMResolutionDecision after the resolver commits, with departure and destination facts tagged by scene. Mixed utterances keep one contract operation and a bounded supporting obligation; travel does not globally override social, and social does not erase committed travel. The six scene-transition regressions pass, as does a Turn 7 reproduction. Suite: 480 passed, 2 failed, 482 collected. The two failures are an ungrounded quoted rule whose closing quote is split off, and an interaction target cleared because guard_captain is not the roster id. Exact model/API calls: 0. Recommendation A.

production: Event-site location is a verb complement, and unresolved cause, actor, and time stay unknown when the sentence says so.
Hedged narrator leads without a speaker, quote, or hearsay verb are unsupported. Attributed NPC speech stays a claim.
reconcile_movement_decision copies a resolved scene transition into the existing GMResolutionDecision after commit.
executable_obligations records one primary act plus at most one supporting committed act. The contract operation is unchanged. One travel stage owns the scene write.
validation: The six tests in tests/test_scene_transition_authority.py now pass.

testing.broader: Scene-transition authority, decision slices 1-3, live attachment, continuation 12-27, resolution contract, outcome precedence, interpretation proposal, model interpretation, unparsed movement, unresolved travel, state authority, bounded improvisation, and social interaction authority.
testing.full_suite: 480 passed, 2 failed, 482 collected in the targeted suite. Not the repository-wide suite. Not the 4x10 gate.
testing.runtime_validation: None. No isolated live probe and no multi-turn validation.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: 0 gameplay turns. 0 generation calls. 0 retry calls. 0 interpretation calls. 0 preflight calls. 0 total model/API calls.

testing.pre_existing_failures: test_calibration_http_captain_answer_does_not_mint_narration_ctx: narration is kept, CTIR records guard_captain, and a later entity rebuild clears the interaction target because that id is not in the gate_guard roster. synchronize_scene_addressability call sites are unchanged from HEAD.

self_contained_review_test: The bundle contains the implementation report, the new deterministic tests, and the production modules that implement qualifier checks, movement reconciliation, and mixed obligations.
decisions_requiring_human_review: A. LOCALIZED DEFECTS ARE REPAIRED; PROCEED TO SMALL MULTI-TURN LIVE VALIDATION.
Do not start the 4x10 gate, a human playtest, or PR-BS on this evidence.
The split-quote harbor line is still removed as an ungrounded rule. Treating every opening quote as a claim reopened harder authority failures.
The guard_captain interaction-target clear is an addressability rebuild against the roster id, not a mixed-intent loss.

campaign_specific: Supporting social acts are narration obligations. They do not also run the social resolver as a second state write.

does_not_prove: Does not rerun the 8-turn live probe.
